info.title: agentsvc.io security checks
info.summary: Pre-trade token checks, scam message and prompt injection detection for AI agents (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon or Arbitrum)
info.description: Five pay-per-call risk checks from agentsvc.io, paid per request with USDC via the x402 protocol on Solana, Base, Polygon or Arbitrum mainnet. No account, no API key. Each service has a free sample endpoint (/api/v1/try/{slug}) that runs the example input. Full catalog: https://agentsvc.io/openapi.json
info.x-guidance: Every POST /api/v1/proxy/{slug} route is paid per call with x402 (USDC on Base mainnet, scheme exact, 0x622efA6Ceb83a5b6EdBC931332f4db68B7f74F27; or USDC on Solana mainnet, 5JzPS5qpEwUM1vTC9GG7uqvwJdHzbEwfoPHf2Ki977tg). Call it without payment to receive HTTP 402 with the requirements (v2 in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, v1 in the body), sign, and retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (v2) or X-PAYMENT (v1). x402 client libraries do this automatically. Payment is settled only after the service succeeded; input errors are never charged. Request bodies are JSON; each route documents its input schema and an example. Catalog with live status: GET https://agentsvc.io/api/v1/services. MCP with in-call x402 payment: https://agentsvc.io/mcp.

x-payment.requirements_v2: base64 JSON in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED response header of the 402
x-payment.receipt_header: PAYMENT-RESPONSE (and X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE): base64 JSON with transaction hash
x-payment.settlement: per call, on-chain, after the service succeeded. Failed calls are never charged.

also_accepted.note: Solana option is accepts[1] in the 402. The facilitator pays the transaction fee (extra.feePayer); the payer needs only USDC, no SOL.

post.summary: Check a token for honeypot and rug risks with detailed flags
post.description:
Token security and honeypot check with risk grade A to F for a token before buying or accepting it, on Solana (SPL and Token-2022) and on Base, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Arbitrum, Polygon, Avalanche or Optimism, computed by us directly on the blockchain. Returns a verdict (low, medium, high, critical, or incomplete if the trade simulation could not run), a one-sentence summary ready to show a user, and concrete flags. EVM: buy and sell simulation in the largest pool, including Uniswap v4 pools with hooks (Clanker, Zora and other launchpads) (honeypot, buy and sell tax), owner powers found in the contract code (mint, blacklist, pause, change tax or limits), upgradeable proxy, SELFDESTRUCT, owner share of supply, burned LP, imitation of major token symbols. Solana: freeze authority (the Solana honeypot pattern), mint authority, permanent delegate, transfer hook, transfer fee, non-transferable, frozen default state, mutable metadata, pump.fun bonding curve, top holder share when available. Both: pool liquidity on the major DEXes, token age and price. Params: token (EVM contract address or Solana mint, required), chain (base default, solana, ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, polygon; a base58 mint is detected as Solana automatically).

Price: $0.009 USDC per successful call, paid via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum mainnet). Without a payment header the response is HTTP 402 with the requirements. Free sample with the example input: POST https://agentsvc.io/api/v1/try/token-security

post.summary: Get a grade A to F and buy-or-avoid verdict for a token
post.description:
Instant buy-or-avoid verdict for a token, with a shareable result page and preview card (share_url): send a contract address (Base, Ethereum, BSC, Arbitrum, Polygon, Avalanche, Optimism) or a Solana mint, get a grade A to F, a label (SAFE, CAUTION, RISKY, DANGER), a 0 to 100 score and a one-line reason, built from real checks: honeypot sell simulation, buy and sell tax, mint, freeze and owner powers, owner powers in the contract code, DEX liquidity and token age, all computed by us on the blockchain. post.summary: Check up to 5 tokens before a trade: ALLOW, CAUTION or BLOCK
post.description:
Honeypot and rug check before a trade, built for trading bots that check every token in a loop: up to 5 token addresses per call (Base, Ethereum, BSC, Arbitrum, Polygon, Avalanche, Optimism or Solana), one decision each: ALLOW, CAUTION or BLOCK, with grade A to F, score, honeypot flag and the main reason. Based on our own on-chain checks (contract code, pools, real buy and sell simulation). Results are cached for 10 minutes, so repeat checks answer in milliseconds. Accepts token, tokenAddress or tokens. Cheaper per token than any single-token verdict.

post.summary: Detect prompt injection in untrusted text
post.description:
Prompt injection detection for AI agents: check untrusted text (a web page, email, tool result or user message) before your agent reads it. Returns a verdict safe, suspicious or malicious, a 0 to 100 risk score, the techniques found (instruction override, role hijack, system prompt extraction, requests to move funds or reveal secrets, fake chat-template tags, hidden unicode, command execution) with exact quotes as evidence, and advice. Combines fixed pattern checks, which can only raise the verdict, with a Claude Haiku 5.5 classifier, so text that tries to talk the classifier into "safe" still gets flagged. Quoted examples in articles about prompt injection are not counted as attacks. Up to 20,000 characters; optional context (what your agent is doing).

Price: $0.004 USDC per successful call, paid via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum mainnet). Without a payment header the response is HTTP 402 with the requirements. Free sample with the example input: POST https://agentsvc.io/api/v1/try/prompt-injection-check

post.summary: Detect crypto scam and phishing messages
post.description:
Scam and phishing detection for crypto wallets, trading bots and social agents: check a DM, cast, tweet, email or comment before your agent or user acts on it. Returns a verdict safe, suspicious or scam, a 0 to 100 risk score, the scam type (wallet drainer, fake airdrop, phishing login, impersonation, seed phrase theft, fake support, giveaway doubling, investment fraud, pig butchering, malware), red flags with exact quotes, and advice. Every link is checked for real: domain age and registration via RDAP, look-alike domains of 40 known brands (uniswap-claims.xyz, rnetamask.io), punycode and link shorteners. Fixed checks can only raise the verdict, so a message that tries to talk the classifier into "safe" still gets flagged. Tron addresses in the message (typical for USDT scams) are checked on chain: never activated or created in the last 7 days is a red flag. Claude Haiku 5.5. Up to 8,000 characters; optional sender and channel.

Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call, paid via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum mainnet). Without a payment header the response is HTTP 402 with the requirements. Free sample with the example input: POST https://agentsvc.io/api/v1/try/scam-message-check
